rleDatabases.intro: The Knowledge Map subproject “Life Extension Databases” collects databases relevant to the goal of radical life extension.
rleDatabases.description: This page will organize databases by levels of living matter, from broad levels such as ecosystems, evolution, and organisms down to cells, genes, molecules, chemistry, and physics. At the top of the page, only databases for the highest level will appear. As you scroll down, the next levels will animate into view while irrelevant ones leave the top. This implements the top-down principle used in the Knowledge Map. The background will change to reflect each level. The animation may move from top to bottom or zoom away from the camera, as in Spore.

callToAction.description: The project is open and free for everyone. Buy a token package to get the complete set of AI tools and support the project's sustainability and growth.

items.question: What is included in the free plan?
items.answer: All free Knowledge Map features: creating knowledge and articles, search and analysis, evidence-based ranking, science monitoring, knowledge graph building, PubMed data, and more.

items.question: How does token billing work?
items.answer: Buy a 50M or 200M token package and use it for AI features. Tokens never expire. AI features pause when the balance reaches zero, and you can buy more at any time.

items.question: Why is this better than a subscription?
items.answer: You pay only for what you use. AI features pause when tokens run out, so you will not receive an unexpectedly large bill.

items.question: Can I buy more than one package?
items.answer: Yes. Tokens add to your balance. You can use part of a 50M package and then buy another package or a 200M package.

items.question: How do I make a purchase?
items.answer: Choose Buy 50M or Buy 200M on a plan card and continue to the payment page. Tokens are added automatically after payment.

items.question: Can I get a refund?
items.answer: If the tokens do not meet your expectations, contact the community. We can refund the unused balance.

hero.title: Defeat aging.
hero.titleContinuation: Live as long as you want.
hero.description: Knowledge Map is a roadmap for achieving radical human life extension. An automated AI scientist connects science, data, and people.
hero.warning: The project is at a very early stage of development; functionality and data preservation are not guaranteed. Statements on this page are for demonstration and may not reflect reality. about.title: What is the Knowledge Map?
about.description: More than a database: a living ecosystem that turns the complexity of scientific information into a structured path toward longevity.

dag.title: Directed acyclic graph (DAG)
dag.description: From fundamental and systems biology and genetics to regenerative therapies and nanomedicine. The paths show how discoveries can move us toward treatments for age-related diseases.

scientist.title: Automated AI scientist
scientist.description: Analyzes large datasets, synthesizes findings from thousands of publications, and helps identify patterns and promising directions for research.

open.title: Open and free
open.description: The project is open and free to everyone, from its ideas to its source code. Science can move faster through collaboration and open access to tools and knowledge.

forum.title: Forum
forum.description: A community to connect, discuss, and follow development news

miro.title: Map (Miro)
miro.description: Demo with 3,000 blocks and 3,000 manually created links

github.title: GitHub
github.description: Explore the source code and contribute

video.title: 10-hour video
video.description: For the most dedicated: everything about the Knowledge Map

progress.title: Tracking scientific progress
progress.description: Follow each technology from ideas and hypotheses through clinical trials and practical use. The map shows progress toward the main goal and promising areas of longevity research.
progress.collaborationDescription: A social network for scientists and everyone interested in the field. Add knowledge, connect concepts, and build a path toward longevity together. Science moves faster when people think together.

graph.title: Interactive graph
graph.description: GPU-accelerated Pixi.js visualization. Create, edit, and delete blocks and links. Keyboard shortcuts (Q/W/E), context menu, and hierarchical levels.

articles.title: Article processing
articles.description: Drag-and-drop PDF upload and Markdown conversion. PubMed and PMC integration, KaTeX formulas and tables, with Marker and HURIDOCS engines.

annotations.title: NLP and annotations
annotations.description: More than 94 annotation types for parts of speech, syntax, and named entities, plus scientific types such as diseases, therapies, genes, and proteins. Manual and automatic annotation with spaCy.

patternMining.title: Pattern mining
patternMining.description: Generate patterns from annotations with SSE streaming. Build and visualize action sequences from text.

literature.title: Scientific literature database
literature.description: An ETL pipeline loads millions of PubMed articles into Neo4j, with a citation graph and full texts from PubMed Central Open Access.

layoutEngine.title: Layout engine (Rust)
layoutEngine.description: SIMD optimization runs nine times faster than the Python version. Rayon parallelizes topological sorting. gRPC API supports streaming.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Sign-up, login, two-factor authentication (2FA), password recovery, and CAPTCHA.

dataExtraction.title: Data extraction
dataExtraction.description: View the original PDF beside Markdown. Annotation, link, pattern, and sequence tabs bring the pipeline into one interface.

aiScientist.title: Generative AI scientist
aiScientist.description: Independently synthesize and test hypotheses, create tasks for manual or automated execution, and help identify promising directions.

knowledgeGraph.title: Expanded knowledge graph
knowledgeGraph.description: Move the 3,000-block, 3,000-link Miro demo into the system, add structural templates, and support real-time collaboration.

ontologies.title: Ontologies and semantics
ontologies.description: Generate semantic ontologies from annotations, provide a GraphQL API for complex queries, and connect entities to UniProt, OMIM, and ChEMBL.

researchNetwork.title: Social network for scientists
researchNetwork.description: Researcher profiles, collaborative workspaces, task management, contribution tracking, and expert reviews.

education.title: Education module
education.description: Spaced repetition and active feedback built into the Knowledge Map, with personalized learning paths.

integration.title: Global integration
integration.description: Synchronize with PubMed, bioRxiv, arXiv, and other research repositories in real time.

callToAction.title: Open and free for everyone
callToAction.description: Defeating aging is a shared human challenge. Join as a researcher, developer, or sponsor.

author.name: Dima Prokofiev
author.quote: “As long as I can remember, I have dreamed that everyone could live for as long as they choose and make the most of that life. The Knowledge Map is an attempt to make that dream real.”
